items.stem: An AI tool provides a quote with a named source. What must a journalist do before publishing it?

options.text: Independently verify that the quote and source are real and accurate
options.rationale: Correct: AI can fabricate quotes and citations, so verification is essential.

options.text: Publish it because the AI named a source
Trust it if the wording sounds plausible
Assume the source consented to be quoted
options.rationale: Consent and existence must both be confirmed.

items.stem: Which TWO steps help a newsroom use AI responsibly? (Select TWO.)

options.text: Disclose to readers when AI materially assisted a story
Publish AI drafts directly to save time
options.rationale: Unchecked drafts risk errors and fabrications.

options.text: Treat AI as a neutral, bias-free tool
options.rationale: AI can reflect and amplify bias.
